metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.9 · 1997 · I Know What You Did Last Summer
metas.description: Four young friends bound by a tragic accident are reunited when they find themselves being stalked by a hook-wielding maniac in their small seaside town.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.8 · 1998 · I Still Know What You Did Last Summer
metas.description: The murderous fisherman with a hook is back to once again stalk the two surviving teens, Julie and Ray, who had left him for dead, as well as cause even more murder and mayhem, this time at a posh island resort.
